records.taskDescription: Build dispatch-eligibility declared operation (#3694 phase 1) - report the real dispatcher admission predicate's own gate trace (shapeDispatchRead/dispatchPlan/planPrepareSpawns), per-item or whole-queue
records.findings: Solid design (reused the real predicate, no forked logic) but independent Codex review found 3 real bugs before landing: (1) whole-queue report could surface a misleading fallback gate instead of the true dispatch-paused reason, (2) one item's thrown error crashed the entire whole-queue report instead of just that row, (3) the read-only operation had a real side effect - it silently consumed a persisted diagnostic verbose-tick budget via the tick CLI. Sent back for a real fix round (logged separately) rather than patched by this session.

records.taskDescription: Fix the 3 bugs independent review found in dispatch-eligibility (paused-gate reporting, whole-queue error containment, read-only side effect on the verbose-tick budget)
records.findings: All 3 confirmed fixed: dispatch-paused now checked and traced first in planPrepareSpawns; whole-queue map now catches per-row errors and reports them inline instead of crashing; readTick/createTickReader now thread an explicit verbose:false so the tick CLI never advances the persisted diagnostic budget on a read-only call, with a regression test asserting the verbose-state file is unchanged. Full verify-lane gate (whole test:unit suite + check:standards) green on the final HEAD. PR #2284 independently reviewed (accept, correctness+security) and merged to main.
